title: Tally Pricing Component
tagline: A neo-brutalist pricing table as a dependency-free Web Component.
description:
Tally is a bold pricing table packaged as a <tally-pricing> custom element. It reads plans from inline JSON, switches between monthly and yearly billing with a configurable discount, formats prices for any currency and locale, and emits a plan-select event when a visitor chooses a plan.

Because it is a standard Web Component with Shadow DOM styles, it drops into React, Vue, Svelte, Astro or plain HTML without a build step. Theme it with CSS custom properties or style its exposed parts.

The download includes the component, a demo page with an event log, a zero-dependency preview server and full documentation.
requirements: Optional: Node.js 18+ for the bundled preview server
technologyNotes: One ES module (src/tally-pricing.js). No dependencies and no build step.
